name: AgriPriceBD
fullName: A Daily Market Price Dataset of Agricultural Commodities of Bangladesh
blurb: Daily prices for five staple commodities, assembled from national market reports and used as the benchmark for the commodity forecasting study.

name: DSE End-of-Day Panel
fullName: Dhaka Stock Exchange End-of-Day Financial Dataset with Coverage Metadata
blurb: End-of-day equity data for the Dhaka Stock Exchange, shipped with per-instrument coverage metadata so that panel construction choices can be audited rather than assumed.

name: ANCHOLIK-NER
fullName: A Benchmark Dataset for Bangla Regional Named Entity Recognition
blurb: Named entity annotations across five regional Bangla varieties. Produced under the REG-NER institutional grant and published with the PLOS ONE paper.

name: Vashantor
fullName: A Large-scale Multilingual Benchmark Dataset for Bangla Regional Dialect Translation
blurb: Parallel dialect-to-standard Bangla corpora covering multiple regional varieties, with baseline translation models and evaluation scripts.

name: BIDWESH
fullName: A Bangla Regional Based Hate Speech Detection Dataset
blurb: Dialectal hate speech annotations, addressing a safety gap that standard-Bangla resources do not cover.
